meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 它接管发布流程:触发 GitHub Actions 的 npm 发布工作流,跑完后核对 npm 包版本、GitHub 发布与 Codex 插件就绪,补写发布摘要并尝试在 Discord 发公告;只做发布,不主动审查或改动代码。
howto.when: 当你说出“publish”“release”“deploy”等发布指令时触发;它要求带升级档位(patch/minor/major)或具体版本号,没给就先停下来问你。

say.text: 帮我发布一个 patch 版本到 npm。
say.note: 它会触发发布工作流并完整验证。

say.text: 发布 minor 版本,上线新功能。
say.note: 它会自动写摘要并在 Discord 发公告。

say.text: 执行发布流程,版本号用 5.0.0-beta.9。
say.note: 它会按该版本发布并核对 npm 结果。

howto.what_en: Takes over the release: triggers the GitHub Actions npm publish workflow, then verifies npm package versions, the GitHub release, and the Codex plugin; writes the release summary and posts a Discord announcement. Ship-only: does not review or fix code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say publish, release, or deploy. It expects a release selector (patch/minor/major or an explicit semver) and asks for one if missing.

say_en.text: Publish a patch version to npm.
say_en.note: It triggers the workflow and runs full verification.

say_en.text: Do a minor release to ship new features.
say_en.note: It drafts the summary and posts a Discord announcement.

say_en.text: Run the release flow with version 5.0.0-beta.9.
say_en.note: It publishes that exact version and verifies it on npm.
